description: An (x, y) point in metres — feeds val-x / val-y (e.g. a Visibility viewer offset).
instructions:
A value source — publishes an (x, y) point in metres on `val-x` / `val-y` (it has no geometry of its own). Wire those outputs into any node that takes a scalar or a viewer offset (e.g. a Visibility Polygon's viewer X/Y). The X/Y can themselves be driven by wiring numbers into `valin-x` / `valin-y`.

TIP: use it as a single adjustable coordinate that several downstream nodes read — move the point and everything that references it follows.
